note: Fishing (core/game/game_fishing.gd, ui/play/fishing_panel.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). The heir fishes from the bank of any sea, lake or river tile (not a ford) with a Fishing rod (items.json); Use at the bank, the Fish key or the thing menu on water opens a short mini-game: a bobber, a bite after a wait, then one tap to reel in on a timing bar. What bites is a pure function of the water body, the biome, the season, the hour and the weather (GameDay.look), rolled on dice keyed on the seed, the tile, the hour and the cast number, never the dynasty's dice, so nothing a life draws moves and the autopilot (which never fishes) is untouched. `species` lists every fish: `item` is its items.json id (every fish is also a pack item, so it has an icon and a price), `to` is where a catch goes (pack, or the family's stores as the 'fish' material that the sailor's stew brews from; a heavy pack sends a pack fish to the stores too), `weight` the odds against the others (before the filters and multipliers), `bodies` (sea, lake, river), `biomes`, `seasons` and `hours` ([from, to), wrapping past midnight) filters (empty = any), `weather` and `biome_mult` odds multipliers, `size` its length range in cm and `rarity` (common, uncommon, rare) which scores points for the Angler level. Bait (worms, found while foraging) is one cheap item used per cast: rarer fish bite more often and sooner. Nothing is lost by a miss but the bait. The record book (GameDynasty.fishing) is saved only once something is caught.

species.name: Trout
species.text: Cold water, quick fins, and a line that suddenly sings.

species.name: Pike
species.text: Teeth first, then temper, then fish.

species.name: Salmon
species.text: Muscle and silver, fighting upstream in your direction.

species.name: Eel
species.text: Something long and cold comes up out of the dark.

species.name: Sturgeon
species.text: An armoured shadow that has outlived every fisherman who named it.

species.name: Mackerel
species.text: Blue stripes flick in the swell and it is yours.

species.name: Cod
species.text: A heavy, grey, honest fish from the cold deep.

species.name: Tuna
species.text: The line screams and the sea heaves; it takes both hands.
